INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator manages a fixed fleet of inbound aircraft. Each
aircraft begins grounded in a pending pool. When it starts its approach it emits
an arrival message that travels over an unordered radio fabric, so pending
arrivals may be processed in any order. A ground controller admits an arriving
aircraft into a bounded holding queue, but only while the queue has spare
capacity -- this backpressure keeps the queue from overflowing. From the queue an
aircraft is assigned to a free runway, and once it has touched down the runway is
released and the aircraft is recorded as landed. No aircraft is ever duplicated
or invented: the same fleet members simply move between pending, in-transit,
queued, on-runway, and landed, each occupying exactly one location at a time. A landed aircraft eventually
returns to the pending pool to fly again.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The pending, in-transit, queued, on-runway, and landed sets always partition the fixed fleet, so no aircraft is ever lost, duplicated, or created.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m2p3t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Slots   == {"s1", "s2"}
Members == {"m1", "m2"}
Locks   == {"L1", "L2"}
NONE    == "none"

VARIABLES grant, ballots, phase, prop, wire
vars == <<grant, ballots, phase, prop, wire>>

Init ==
    /\ grant   = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ ballots = [k \in Locks |-> NONE]
    /\ phase   = "open"
    /\ prop    = [slot |-> NONE, member |-> NONE]
    /\ wire    = {}

Propose(s, m) ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ grant[s] = NONE
    /\ prop'    = [slot |-> s, member |-> m]
    /\ phase'   = "polling"
    /\ ballots' = [k \in Locks |-> NONE]
    /\ wire'    = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED grant

Emit(k, b) ==
    /\ phase = "polling"
    /\ ballots[k] = NONE
    /\ ~ \E msg \in wire : msg.lock = k
    /\ wire' = wire \cup {[lock |-> k, ok |-> b]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grant, ballots, phase, prop>>

Count(msg) ==
    /\ phase = "polling"
    /\ msg \in wire
    /\ ballots[msg.lock] = NONE
    /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![msg.lock] = msg.ok]
    /\ wire'    = wire \ {msg}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grant, phase, prop>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "polling"
    /\ \A k \in Locks : ballots[k] = "yes"
    /\ grant'  = [grant EXCEPT ![prop.slot] = prop.member]
    /\ phase'  = "open"
    /\ prop'   = [slot |-> NONE, member |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballots, wire>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "polling"
    /\ \E k \in Locks : ballots[k] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "open"
    /\ prop'  = [slot |-> NONE, member |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grant, ballots, wire>>

Revoke(s) ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ grant[s] # NONE
    /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballots, phase, prop, wire>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Slots, m \in Members : Propose(s, m)
    \/ \E k \in Locks, b \in {"yes","no"} : Emit(k, b)
    \/ \E msg \in wire : Count(msg)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Revoke(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ grant   \in [Slots -> Members \cup {NONE}]
    /\ ballots \in [Locks -> {"yes", "no", NONE}]
    /\ phase   \in {"open", "polling"}
    /\ wire    \subseteq [lock : Locks, ok : {"yes", "no"}]

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    (phase = "polling") => (grant[prop.slot] = NONE)
====

NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network grants time-boxed access slots to household
members. Because a single physical slot must never be handed to two members at
once, the hub commits each grant with two-phase commit: a coordinator proposes
binding a free slot to a member, every lock participant votes, and the grant is
committed only on a unanimous yes. One lock can be slow -- its vote is queued in
an in-transit buffer and delivered later -- but it never fails outright, so every
vote eventually lands and is counted exactly once. A committed slot can later be
revoked, returning it to the free pool for a future round. A new voting round is
only ever opened on a slot that is currently free.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a voting round is in progress, the slot it targets is currently unowned, so a slot is never committed to a second member while already granted.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m5p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
Cars  == {"c1", "c2"}
NONE  == "none"

VARIABLES grantedTo, occupant, crashed, seeking
vars == <<grantedTo, occupant, crashed, seeking>>

GrantsFor(c) == { n \in Nodes : grantedTo[n] = c }
Quorum(c)    == Cardinality(GrantsFor(c)) >= 2

Init ==
    /\ grantedTo = [n \in Nodes |-> NONE]
    /\ occupant  = NONE
    /\ crashed   = {}
    /\ seeking   = [c \in Cars |-> FALSE]

StartSeek(c) ==
    /\ ~ seeking[c]
    /\ occupant # c
    /\ seeking' = [seeking EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grantedTo, occupant, crashed>>

Grant(n, c) ==
    /\ n \notin crashed
    /\ grantedTo[n] = NONE
    /\ seeking[c]
    /\ grantedTo' = [grantedTo EXCEPT ![n] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, crashed, seeking>>

Enter(c) ==
    /\ seeking[c]
    /\ occupant = NONE
    /\ Quorum(c)
    /\ occupant' = c
    /\ seeking'  = [seeking EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grantedTo, crashed>>

Leave(c) ==
    /\ occupant = c
    /\ occupant'  = NONE
    /\ grantedTo' = [n \in Nodes |-> IF grantedTo[n] = c THEN NONE ELSE grantedTo[n]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, seeking>>

Crash(n) ==
    /\ n \notin crashed
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 1
    /\ crashed'   = crashed \cup {n}
    /\ grantedTo' = [grantedTo EXCEPT ![n] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, seeking>>

Withdraw(c) ==
    /\ seeking[c]
    /\ grantedTo' = [n \in Nodes |-> IF grantedTo[n] = c THEN NONE ELSE grantedTo[n]]
    /\ seeking'   = [seeking EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, crashed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : StartSeek(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Withdraw(c)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, c \in Cars : Grant(n, c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Enter(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Leave(c)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ grantedTo \in [Nodes -> Cars \cup {NONE}]
    /\ occupant  \in Cars \cup {NONE}
    /\ crashed   \subseteq Nodes
    /\ seeking   \in [Cars -> BOOLEAN]

Mutex ==
    \A a, b \in Cars : (Quorum(a) /\ Quorum(b)) => (a = b)
====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Mutex
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line has a single wash bay that only one car may occupy at a
time. Access is arbitrated by quorum voting: three bay-controller nodes each hand
their grant to at most one requesting car, and a car may enter the bay only once
it has collected grants from a majority (at least two) of the nodes. Because any
two majorities must share a node, and a node never grants to two cars at once,
two different cars can never both hold a quorum. One node may crash silently at
runtime -- it stops issuing grants and its outstanding grant is dropped -- but the
majority rule keeps arbitration safe with the remaining nodes. When a car leaves
the bay it releases all of its grants back to the nodes, and a still-waiting car
may withdraw its request, returning its grants so another car can try.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No two distinct cars ever simultaneously hold a majority quorum of node grants, and any car occupying the bay holds such a quorum.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m6p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Zones  == {"z1", "z2"}
Robots == {"r1", "r2"}
LEASE  == 2
HORIZON == 3
NONE   == "none"

VARIABLES owner, expiry, acting, clock, openZones
vars == <<owner, expiry, acting, clock, openZones>>

Init ==
    /\ owner     = [z \in Zones |-> NONE]
    /\ expiry    = [z \in Zones |-> 0]
    /\ acting    = [z \in Zones |-> NONE]
    /\ clock     = 0
    /\ openZones = Zones

Acquire(z, r) ==
    /\ z \in openZones
    /\ owner[z] = NONE
    /\ owner'  = [owner  EXCEPT ![z] = r]
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![z] = clock + LEASE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<acting, clock, openZones>>

Renew(z, r) ==
    /\ owner[z] = r
    /\ expiry[z] >= clock
    /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![z] = clock + LEASE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, acting, clock, openZones>>

Act(z, r) ==
    /\ owner[z] = r
    /\ expiry[z] >= clock
    /\ acting[z] = NONE
    /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![z] = r]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, clock, openZones>>

Finish(z) ==
    /\ acting[z] # NONE
    /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![z] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, clock, openZones>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < HORIZON
    /\ \A z \in Zones : (acting[z] = NONE) \/ (expiry[z] > clock)
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, acting, openZones>>

CloseZone(z) ==
    /\ z \in openZones
    /\ acting[z] = NONE
    /\ openZones' = openZones \ {z}
    /\ owner'  = [owner  EXCEPT ![z] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<expiry, acting, clock>>

OpenZone(z) ==
    /\ z \notin openZones
    /\ openZones' = openZones \cup {z}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, expiry, acting, clock>>

Next ==
    \/ \E z \in Zones, r \in Robots : Acquire(z, r)
    \/ \E z \in Zones, r \in Robots : Renew(z, r)
    \/ \E z \in Zones, r \in Robots : Act(z, r)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : Finish(z)
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E z \in Zones : CloseZone(z)
    \/ \E z \in Zones : OpenZone(z)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner     \in [Zones -> Robots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ expiry    \in [Zones -> 0..(HORIZON + LEASE)]
    /\ acting    \in [Zones -> Robots \cup {NONE}]
    /\ clock     \in 0..HORIZON
    /\ openZones \subseteq Zones

Authorized ==
    \A z \in Zones :
        (acting[z] # NONE) =>
            /\ owner[z] = acting[z]
            /\ expiry[z] >= clock
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Authorized
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet coordinates work over floor zones using lease-based
ownership. To operate in a zone a robot must first acquire a lease, which is
stamped with an expiry epoch; only the current lease holder may act in that zone,
and only while its lease has not yet expired. A robot renews its lease before the
boundary if it needs more time. The set of open zones changes at runtime -- the
warehouse can open a new zone or close one for maintenance, and closing a zone
clears any lease on it. The fleet clock advances in discrete epochs, but it never
steps past the expiry of a lease that a robot is still actively using, so no robot
is ever caught acting on an expired lease. An unauthorized robot -- one that does
not hold the zone's lease -- can never act in that zone.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every zone currently being acted upon is held by exactly the robot doing the acting, under a lease that has not expired.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m3p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Nodes    == {"a", "b", "c"}
Updates  == {"u1", "u2"}
MAXTERM  == 3
NONE     == "none"

VARIABLES currentTerm, leader, nodeTerm, record, recordTerm, alive
vars == <<currentTerm, leader, nodeTerm, record, recordTerm, alive>>

Init ==
    /\ currentTerm = 0
    /\ leader      = NONE
    /\ nodeTerm    = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ record      = NONE
    /\ recordTerm  = 0
    /\ alive       = Nodes

Elect(n) ==
    /\ n \in alive
    /\ currentTerm < MAXTERM
    /\ leader # n
    /\ currentTerm' = currentTerm + 1
    /\ leader'      = n
    /\ nodeTerm'    = [nodeTerm EXCEPT ![n] = currentTerm + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, recordTerm, alive>>

Write(n, u) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ n \in alive
    /\ nodeTerm[n] = currentTerm
    /\ record'     = u
    /\ recordTerm' = currentTerm
    /\ UNCHANGED <<currentTerm, leader, nodeTerm, alive>>

Fail(n) ==
    /\ n \in alive
    /\ alive' = alive \ {n}
    /\ leader' = IF leader = n THEN NONE ELSE leader
    /\ UNCHANGED <<currentTerm, nodeTerm, record, recordTerm>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ n \notin alive
    /\ alive' = alive \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<currentTerm, leader, nodeTerm, record, recordTerm>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, u \in Updates : Write(n, u)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Fail(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ currentTerm \in 0..MAXTERM
    /\ leader      \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ nodeTerm    \in [Nodes -> 0..MAXTERM]
    /\ record      \in Updates \cup {NONE}
    /\ recordTerm  \in 0..MAXTERM
    /\ alive       \subseteq Nodes

NoStaleWrite ==
    /\ recordTerm <= currentTerm
    /\ (leader # NONE) => (nodeTerm[leader] = currentTerm)
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleWrite
nl:
An airport baggage router keeps a single shared routing record that maps bags to
carousels. Router nodes elect a leader for each term, and only the leader of the
current term may write updates to the record; each write stamps the record with
the writing leader's term. Terms increase monotonically with every election, so
once the record has been advanced under a newer term a stale former leader can
never come back and clobber it with an older write -- updates are never lost. The
router supports failover: the leader can fail, dropping out of the live set, after
which a surviving node is elected under a fresh, higher term. The live set of
nodes changes at runtime as nodes fail and recover.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared record is never stamped with a term newer than the current term, and the standing leader always holds the current term, so no stale leader ever overwrites a fresher update.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od9m3p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Nodes   == {"s1", "s2", "s3"}
Feeders == {"f1", "f2"}
MAXTERM == 3
NONE    == "none"

VARIABLES term, coord, nodeTerm, wire, shedBy
vars == <<term, coord, nodeTerm, wire, shedBy>>

Init ==
    /\ term     = 0
    /\ coord    = NONE
    /\ nodeTerm = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ wire     = {}
    /\ shedBy   = [f \in Feeders |-> NONE]

Elect(n) ==
    /\ term < MAXTERM
    /\ coord # n
    /\ term'     = term + 1
    /\ coord'    = n
    /\ nodeTerm' = [nodeTerm EXCEPT ![n] = term + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<wire, shedBy>>

IssueShed(f) ==
    /\ coord # NONE
    /\ nodeTerm[coord] = term
    /\ ~ \E c \in wire : c.feeder = f /\ c.issuer = coord /\ c.term = term
    /\ wire' = wire \cup {[feeder |-> f, issuer |-> coord, term |-> term]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, coord, nodeTerm, shedBy>>

Deliver(c) ==
    /\ c \in wire
    /\ c.term = term
    /\ shedBy'  = [shedBy EXCEPT ![c.feeder] = c.issuer]
    /\ wire'    = wire \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, coord, nodeTerm>>

DropStale(c) ==
    /\ c \in wire
    /\ c.term < term
    /\ wire' = wire \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, coord, nodeTerm, shedBy>>

Restore(f) ==
    /\ shedBy[f] # NONE
    /\ shedBy' = [shedBy EXCEPT ![f] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, coord, nodeTerm, wire>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : IssueShed(f)
    \/ \E c \in wire : Deliver(c)
    \/ \E c \in wire : DropStale(c)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Restore(f)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ term     \in 0..MAXTERM
    /\ coord    \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ nodeTerm \in [Nodes -> 0..MAXTERM]
    /\ wire     \subseteq [feeder : Feeders, issuer : Nodes, term : 0..MAXTERM]
    /\ shedBy   \in [Feeders -> Nodes \cup {NONE}]

NoStaleAction ==
    /\ (coord # NONE) => (nodeTerm[coord] = term)
    /\ \A c \in wire : (c.term = term) => (c.issuer = coord)
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleAction
nl:
A power-grid load shedder is driven by an elected coordinator. Substation nodes
elect a coordinator for each term, terms increasing with every election, and only
the coordinator of the current term is authorized to issue load-shed commands.
Commands travel to feeders over a control bus that can be slow: a command may sit
in transit for a while before it is delivered, but no node fails outright. A feeder
applies a shed command only if the command still carries the current term; a
command left over from an older term is stale and is discarded rather than applied,
so a demoted former coordinator can never shed a feeder. The coordinator can fail
over to a successor, which is elected under a fresh higher term.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The standing coordinator always holds the current term, and no command carrying the current term is ever in transit from anyone other than the current coordinator.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m8p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Regions == {"R1", "R2"}
Cells   == {"c1", "c2", "c3", "c4"}
Drones  == {"d1", "d2"}
MAXV    == 2
NONE    == "none"

Region(c) == IF c \in {"c1", "c2"} THEN "R1" ELSE "R2"
CellsOf(rg) == { c \in Cells : Region(c) = rg }

VARIABLES coarse, fine, writing, record
vars == <<coarse, fine, writing, record>>

Init ==
    /\ coarse  = [rg \in Regions |-> NONE]
    /\ fine    = [c \in Cells |-> NONE]
    /\ writing = [c \in Cells |-> NONE]
    /\ record  = [c \in Cells |-> 0]

AcquireCoarse(rg, d) ==
    /\ coarse[rg] = NONE
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![rg] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, writing, record>>

AcquireFine(c, d) ==
    /\ coarse[Region(c)] = d
    /\ fine[c] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![c] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, writing, record>>

BeginWrite(c, d) ==
    /\ fine[c] = d
    /\ writing[c] = NONE
    /\ record[c] < MAXV
    /\ writing' = [writing EXCEPT ![c] = d]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, record>>

EndWrite(c) ==
    /\ writing[c] # NONE
    /\ record'  = [record EXCEPT ![c] = record[c] + 1]
    /\ writing' = [writing EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

ReleaseFine(c, d) ==
    /\ fine[c] = d
    /\ writing[c] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, writing, record>>

ReleaseCoarse(rg, d) ==
    /\ coarse[rg] = d
    /\ \A c \in CellsOf(rg) : fine[c] = NONE
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![rg] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, writing, record>>

AdminOverride(rg) ==
    /\ coarse[rg] # NONE
    /\ coarse'  = [coarse EXCEPT ![rg] = NONE]
    /\ fine'    = [c \in Cells |-> IF Region(c) = rg THEN NONE ELSE fine[c]]
    /\ writing' = [c \in Cells |-> IF Region(c) = rg THEN NONE ELSE writing[c]]
    /\ UNCHANGED record

Next ==
    \/ \E rg \in Regions, d \in Drones : AcquireCoarse(rg, d)
    \/ \E c \in Cells, d \in Drones : AcquireFine(c, d)
    \/ \E c \in Cells, d \in Drones : BeginWrite(c, d)
    \/ \E c \in Cells : EndWrite(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cells, d \in Drones : ReleaseFine(c, d)
    \/ \E rg \in Regions, d \in Drones : ReleaseCoarse(rg, d)
    \/ \E rg \in Regions : AdminOverride(rg)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse  \in [Regions -> Drones \cup {NONE}]
    /\ fine    \in [Cells -> Drones \cup {NONE}]
    /\ writing \in [Cells -> Drones \cup {NONE}]
    /\ record  \in [Cells -> 0..MAXV]

LockConsistent ==
    /\ \A c \in Cells : (fine[c] # NONE) => (coarse[Region(c)] = fine[c])
    /\ \A c \in Cells : (writing[c] # NONE) => (fine[c] = writing[c])
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LockConsistent
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm updates a shared observation record for each
map cell. Cells are grouped into regions, and access is guarded by hierarchical
locks: a drone must first take the coarse lock on a region, and only then may it
take the fine lock on a cell inside that region. A drone may write to a cell's
record only while it holds that cell's fine lock, which serializes writes so no
update is ever lost to a concurrent writer. A privileged admin can override the
locks -- forcibly releasing a region's coarse lock, which also clears every fine
lock and any in-progress write inside that region, keeping the lock hierarchy
consistent. A drone releases its fine lock before releasing the enclosing coarse
lock.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any held fine lock is backed by the same drone holding the enclosing coarse lock, and any in-progress write on a cell is by the drone that holds that cell's fine lock.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m4p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Cases == {"p1", "p2", "p3"}
Rooms == {"o1", "o2"}
QCAP  == 2
NONE  == "none"

VARIABLES pool, queue, inRoom, roomBusy, crashed
vars == <<pool, queue, inRoom, roomBusy, crashed>>

InRoomCases == { c \in Cases : inRoom[c] # NONE }

Init ==
    /\ pool     = Cases
    /\ queue    = {}
    /\ inRoom   = [c \in Cases |-> NONE]
    /\ roomBusy = [r \in Rooms |-> NONE]
    /\ crashed  = {}

Admit(c) ==
    /\ c \in pool
    /\ Cardinality(queue) < QCAP
    /\ pool'  = pool \ {c}
    /\ queue' = queue \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inRoom, roomBusy, crashed>>

Assign(c, r) ==
    /\ c \in queue
    /\ roomBusy[r] = NONE
    /\ queue'    = queue \ {c}
    /\ inRoom'   = [inRoom EXCEPT ![c] = r]
    /\ roomBusy' = [roomBusy EXCEPT ![r] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, crashed>>

Complete(c) ==
    /\ inRoom[c] # NONE
    /\ roomBusy' = [roomBusy EXCEPT ![inRoom[c]] = NONE]
    /\ inRoom'   = [inRoom EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ pool'     = pool \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, crashed>>

Crash(c) ==
    /\ inRoom[c] # NONE
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 1
    /\ roomBusy' = [roomBusy EXCEPT ![inRoom[c]] = NONE]
    /\ inRoom'   = [inRoom EXCEPT ![c] = NONE]
    /\ pool'     = pool \cup {c}
    /\ crashed'  = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED queue

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cases : Admit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cases, r \in Rooms : Assign(c, r)
    \/ \E c \in Cases : Complete(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cases : Crash(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool     \subseteq Cases
    /\ queue    \subseteq Cases
    /\ inRoom   \in [Cases -> Rooms \cup {NONE}]
    /\ roomBusy \in [Rooms -> Cases \cup {NONE}]
    /\ crashed  \subseteq Cases

Mutex ==
    /\ (pool \cup queue \cup InRoomCases) = Cases
    /\ pool \cap queue = {}
    /\ pool \cap InRoomCases = {}
    /\ queue \cap InRoomCases = {}
    /\ \A c1, c2 \in Cases :
           (inRoom[c1] # NONE /\ inRoom[c1] = inRoom[c2]) => (c1 = c2)
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Mutex
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler admits surgical cases through a bounded intake
queue. New cases wait in a holding pool; a case is admitted into the queue only
while the queue has spare capacity, and this backpressure prevents the queue from
overflowing. An admitted case is assigned to a free operating room, where it is
operated to completion; a room hosts at most one case at a time, and the case and
room records always agree on who is where. One case can crash silently mid-
operation -- its surgery aborts without notice -- which frees the room and returns
the case to the holding pool. Completed cases also return to the pool.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The case-to-room and room-to-case assignments are always mutually consistent, so no operating room ever holds two cases at once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m0p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Cars == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES version, occupant, snapshot, pending, crashed
vars == <<version, occupant, snapshot, pending, crashed>>

    /\ pending  = [c \in Cars |-> FALSE]
    /\ crashed  = {}

Read(c) ==
    /\ occupant # c
    /\ snapshot' = [snapshot EXCEPT ![c] = version]
    /\ pending'  = [pending EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, occupant, crashed>>

Enter(c) ==
    /\ pending[c]
    /\ snapshot[c] = version
    /\ occupant = NONE
    /\ occupant' = c
    /\ version'  = 1
    /\ pending'  = [pending EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snapshot, crashed>>

Retry(c) ==
    /\ pending[c]
    /\ snapshot[c] # version
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, occupant, snapshot, crashed>>

Leave(c) ==
    /\ occupant = c
    /\ occupant' = NONE
    /\ version'  = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snapshot, pending, crashed>>

Crash(c) ==
    /\ occupant = c
    /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 1
    /\ occupant' = NONE
    /\ version'  = 0
    /\ crashed'  = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snapshot, pending>>

    \/ \E c \in Cars : Enter(c)

successful entry flips the guard to its occupied generation; leaving the bay
resets it to the free generation. A car whose read has gone stale (the version
moved under it) abandons its attempt and retries with a fresh read. One car may
crash silently while in the bay, which frees the bay and resets the guard just as
a normal exit would.

---- MODULE W4Od10m8p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Lines  == {"L1", "L2"}
Blocks == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Ctrls  == {"x", "y"}
MAXV   == 1
NONE   == "none"

Line(b) == IF b \in {"c1", "c2"} THEN "L1" ELSE "L2"
BlocksOf(ln) == { b \in Blocks : Line(b) = ln }

VARIABLES coarse, fine, writing, record, wire
vars == <<coarse, fine, writing, record, wire>>

Init ==
    /\ coarse  = [ln \in Lines |-> NONE]
    /\ fine    = [b \in Blocks |-> NONE]
    /\ writing = [b \in Blocks |-> NONE]
    /\ record  = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
    /\ wire    = {}

ReqCoarse(ct, ln) ==
    /\ ~ \E m \in wire : m.kind = "coarse" /\ m.ctrl = ct /\ m.target = ln
    /\ wire' = wire \cup {[kind |-> "coarse", ctrl |-> ct, target |-> ln]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, writing, record>>

ReqFine(ct, b) ==
    /\ ~ \E m \in wire : m.kind = "fine" /\ m.ctrl = ct /\ m.target = b
    /\ wire' = wire \cup {[kind |-> "fine", ctrl |-> ct, target |-> b]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, writing, record>>

GrantCoarse(m) ==
    /\ m \in wire
    /\ m.kind = "coarse"
    /\ coarse[m.target] = NONE
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![m.target] = m.ctrl]
    /\ wire'   = wire \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, writing, record>>

GrantFine(m) ==
    /\ m \in wire
    /\ m.kind = "fine"
    /\ fine[m.target] = NONE
    /\ coarse[Line(m.target)] = m.ctrl
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![m.target] = m.ctrl]
    /\ wire' = wire \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, writing, record>>

BeginWrite(b, ct) ==
    /\ fine[b] = ct
    /\ writing[b] = NONE
    /\ record[b] < MAXV
    /\ writing' = [writing EXCEPT ![b] = ct]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, record, wire>>

EndWrite(b) ==
    /\ writing[b] # NONE
    /\ record'  = [record EXCEPT ![b] = record[b] + 1]
    /\ writing' = [writing EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, wire>>

ReleaseFine(b, ct) ==
    /\ fine[b] = ct
    /\ writing[b] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![b] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, writing, record, wire>>

ReleaseCoarse(ln, ct) ==
    /\ coarse[ln] = ct
    /\ \A b \in BlocksOf(ln) : fine[b] = NONE
    /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![ln] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, writing, record, wire>>

Next ==
    \/ \E ct \in Ctrls, ln \in Lines : ReqCoarse(ct, ln)
    \/ \E ct \in Ctrls, b \in Blocks : ReqFine(ct, b)
    \/ \E m \in wire : GrantCoarse(m)
    \/ \E m \in wire : GrantFine(m)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks, ct \in Ctrls : BeginWrite(b, ct)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : EndWrite(b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks, ct \in Ctrls : ReleaseFine(b, ct)
    \/ \E ln \in Lines, ct \in Ctrls : ReleaseCoarse(ln, ct)

    /\ coarse  \in [Lines -> Ctrls \cup {NONE}]
    /\ fine    \in [Blocks -> Ctrls \cup {NONE}]
    /\ writing \in [Blocks -> Ctrls \cup {NONE}]
    /\ record  \in [Blocks -> 0..MAXV]
    /\ wire    \subseteq [kind : {"coarse", "fine"}, ctrl : Ctrls, target : Lines \cup Blocks]

    /\ \A b \in Blocks : (fine[b] # NONE) => (coarse[Line(b)] = fine[b])

granted when the line is free, and a fine request only when the block is free and
the requester already holds the enclosing line's coarse lock. A controller releases
a block's fine lock before releasing the line's coarse lock.

An elevator bank in a skyscraper is driven by two independent dispatch controllers
that share one common pool of call-board records (a north board and a south board).
Each record is guarded by a version, and a controller updates a record with a
read-modify-write: it reads the record's version, then commits with a compare-and-
swap that is accepted only if the version it read still matches the record's current
version. An accepted commit advances the version by one and remembers the version
the writer presented, so a controller whose read went stale is rejected and retries
-- two controllers writing the same board can never lose each other's updates. The
building can also refresh a board when a call is serviced, which advances its
version as a write of its own.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every call-board record that has been written at least once, the version presented by the most recently accepted writer is exactly one less than the record's current version, so no update was ever silently lost.
